sentences.en: My apathy for voting comes from my distaste for politics.
sentences.zh: 我对投票不感兴趣是因为我不喜欢政治。

sentences.en: Great Britain is no longer in control of world politics.
sentences.zh: 英国已不再掌控世界政治。

sentences.en: In general, young people today are not interested in politics.
sentences.zh: 一般来说，现在的年轻人对政治不太感兴趣。

senses.zh: 政治活动 - 政治学 - 政论，政见；党派倾向 - 权术；派别之争
